payload.name: WorkStory
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: WorkStory helps employees and managers understand their organization, feedback, goals, performance reviews, and review cycles. It can also request feedback from selected teammates.
payload.longDescription: WorkStory 帮助员工和管理者了解组织、反馈、目标、绩效评审和评审周期。它还可以向指定的团队成员征求反馈。

payload.name: Trendata Market Intelligence
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Trendata connects you to real-time market intelligence and consumer search data. It allows you to easily analyze global locations, product categories, and specific brands or retailers directly within your workflow. By providing historical search volumes and concrete growth metrics, you can accurately spot consumer preferences and changing market trends. It turns complex data into clear, actionable insights for smarter business decisions.
payload.longDescription: Trendata 可连接实时市场情报和消费者搜索数据。你可以直接在工作流中轻松分析全球地区、产品类别以及特定品牌或零售商。通过提供历史搜索量和具体增长指标，你可以准确发现消费者偏好和不断变化的市场趋势。它将复杂数据转化为清晰、可执行的洞察，帮助做出更明智的业务决策。

payload.name: Abacor
payload.description: 查看会议记录与上下文
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Abacor turns your client meetings and conversations into searchable, structured intelligence, built for accounting firms.

Connect Abacor to ChatGPT to:
- Search across meeting notes, transcripts, and summaries from past client conversations
- Recall what a specific client said, asked for, or committed to
- Pull open action items across your book of business or for a single engagement
- Get a prep brief before any upcoming meeting on your calendar
- Look up contacts and organizations synced from your practice management system

Abacor records and summarizes your meetings, extracts action items, and ties every conversation back to the right contact and organization. All data stays scoped to your Abacor workspace.
payload.longDescription:
Abacor 专为会计师事务所打造，将客户会议和对话转化为可搜索、结构化的情报。

将 Abacor 连接至 ChatGPT，可：
- 搜索过往客户对话的会议记录、转录和摘要
- 回顾特定客户说过什么、提出什么要求或作出什么承诺
- 提取整个客户业务或单个业务项目中尚未完成的行动事项
- 在日历中任何即将举行的会议前获取准备简报
- 查询从事务管理系统同步的联系人和组织

Abacor 录制并总结会议、提取行动事项，将每段对话关联至正确的联系人和组织。所有数据的访问范围始终限于你的 Abacor 工作区。

payload.name: Compoundio Technology Cloud
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Compoundio Technology Cloud helps founders explore the Compoundio portfolio, describe a
  business goal, and receive a practical venture match with suggested next questions.

  The app uses public Compoundio information and read-only tools. No contact details are
  required. It does not submit forms or contact companies. External links open only after the
  user actively selects them.
payload.longDescription:
Compoundio Technology Cloud 帮助创始人探索 Compoundio 组合项目，描述业务目标，并获得实用的创投匹配和建议的后续问题。

该应用使用 Compoundio 的公开信息和只读工具。无需提供联系方式，不会提交表单或联系公司。只有在用户主动选择后才会打开外部链接。

payload.name: Northwest Registered Agent
payload.description: 注册 LLC 与企业身份
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Northwest Registered Agent is a family-owned and -operated Business Identity service that gives you everything you need to start and grow your business. We form companies in all 50 states, provide registered agent service, and offer free identity services including a free address, domain, website, email, and local phone number.
All services are built in-house with Privacy by Default®, and your data is never sold or traded to third parties. We have an expert team of Corporate Guides® who stay available to answer questions throughout the life of your business, not just at signup.
payload.longDescription:
Northwest Registered Agent 是一家家族经营的 Business Identity 服务，为你启动和发展企业提供所需的一切。我们在全美 50 个州设立公司，提供注册代理服务，并免费提供地址、域名、网站、邮箱和本地电话号码等身份服务。
所有服务均由内部构建，遵循 Privacy by Default®，绝不向第三方出售或交易你的数据。我们的 Corporate Guides® 专家团队会在企业整个生命周期中持续回答问题，而不只是注册时提供帮助。

payload.name: NETAQ
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: NETAQ is a Saudi AI-powered digital marketing agency assistant. Estimate a project's cost range (e-commerce store, mobile app, ads, social, SEO & GEO, design, strategy), get a recommendation for the right service, save your details so the NETAQ team can follow up, see available consultation slots, and book a free consultation. NETAQ serves Saudi Arabia and the Gulf.
payload.longDescription: NETAQ 是沙特的 AI 数字营销代理助手。估算项目成本范围（电商店铺、移动应用、广告、社交媒体、SEO 与 GEO、设计、战略），获得合适服务建议，保存信息供 NETAQ 团队跟进，查看可用咨询时段并预约免费咨询。NETAQ 服务沙特阿拉伯和海湾地区。

payload.name: ClearBounce
payload.description: 验证并查找电子邮件地址
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: ClearBounce verifies email addresses in real time inside ChatGPT. Ask whether an address is safe to email and it runs a full check - syntax, MX records, a live mailbox check, disposable and role-account detection, typo rescue and risk scoring - returning a clear status and a 0-100 quality score. It can also find a person's business email from a name and company domain, and report your remaining credit balance. Sign-in uses OAuth: your password never passes through the chat. New accounts include 100 free credits.
payload.longDescription: ClearBounce 在 ChatGPT 内实时验证电子邮件地址。询问某地址是否适合发送邮件，它会执行完整检查——语法、MX 记录、实时邮箱检查、一次性邮箱和角色账户检测、拼写纠错与风险评分——并返回清晰状态和 0–100 质量分。它还可以根据姓名和公司域名查找某人的企业邮箱，并报告剩余信用额度。使用 OAuth 登录，密码不会经过聊天。新账户包含 100 个免费额度。

payload.name: SAIRYŌ
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
SAIRYŌ helps event organizers and customers use ChatGPT to search their events and reports, fetch event or revenue details, and review ticket-sales KPI snapshots for a requested date range. It will also allow hosts to create their own events with a link to complete on SAIRYŌ's website. 

The app does not facilitate in-chat commerce, payment, order creation, ticket fulfillment, transfers, or digital goods. It is limited to event discovery, event information, ticket tier display, and providing a link to the official SAIRYŌ.live page where any transaction is completed directly by the user.

Note: The SAIRYŌ ChatGPT app receives only the minimum information required to respond to a user’s event-related request, such as event ID, city, date range, category, ticket tier ID, or quantity. The app does not receive full conversation history, payment card details, or unrelated personal information. Purchases, payments, refunds, and ticket fulfillment occur only on SAIRYŌ.live and are governed by SAIRYŌ’s website terms and privacy policy.
payload.longDescription:
SAIRYŌ 帮助活动组织者和客户通过 ChatGPT 搜索活动及报告、获取活动或收入详情，并查看指定日期范围内的票务销售 KPI 快照。主办方还可以创建自己的活动，并通过链接前往 SAIRYŌ 网站完成后续操作。

此应用不支持在聊天中进行商业交易、付款、创建订单、履行票务、转让或数字商品交易。它仅用于发现活动、查看活动信息、展示票档，并提供指向 SAIRYŌ.live 官方页面的链接；任何交易都由用户直接在该页面完成。

注意：SAIRYŌ ChatGPT 应用仅接收响应用户活动相关请求所需的最少信息，例如活动 ID、城市、日期范围、类别、票档 ID 或数量。应用不会接收完整对话记录、支付卡详情或无关个人信息。购买、付款、退款和票务履行仅在 SAIRYŌ.live 上进行，并受 SAIRYŌ 网站条款和隐私政策约束。

payload.name: Hadaly
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Hadaly is a leading platform for business valuation, pre-sale company organization, data room preparation, and transaction readiness. It helps business owners estimate the value of their company, track its value over time, and understand how to improve it.
payload.longDescription: Hadaly 是企业估值、出售前公司整理、数据室准备和交易准备平台。它帮助企业主估算公司价值、追踪价值变化，并了解如何提升价值。

payload.name: Vettara
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Vettara lets authorized workspace users prepare executive-search briefs, create editable MCP search sessions, launch private candidate searches, monitor run status, review compact candidate results, and export completed project CSVs from ChatGPT. Access is enforced through Vettara OAuth and each user only sees records available to their Vettara workspace permissions. Vettara supports sourcing and research workflows only and does not make hiring decisions.
payload.longDescription: Vettara 允许获授权的工作区用户准备高管寻访简报、创建可编辑的 MCP 搜索会话、启动私密候选人搜索、监控运行状态、查看精简的候选人结果，并从 ChatGPT 导出已完成项目的 CSV。访问权限通过 Vettara OAuth 强制执行，每位用户只能查看其 Vettara 工作区权限允许访问的记录。Vettara 仅支持人才寻访和研究工作流程，不会作出招聘决定。

payload.name: Scribble
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Scribble sends real handwritten cards. A machine holds an actual pen and writes each card and envelope in ink, then we stamp it and put it in the post anywhere in the United States. Nothing is a printed font.

Connect this and you can ask ChatGPT to look someone up in your address book, draft the card, and send it — and it shows you a picture of the card first, written in the handwriting that will actually be used, alongside the printed front. Ask to see the handwriting styles and it writes you a real specimen of each. You can also load a spreadsheet of contacts, send a personalised batch where every card says a different name, and set up a rule that sends birthday cards every year on its own.

Cards are paid for with credits bought in advance on scribblecards.com, so nothing here takes a payment or links to a checkout. Sending is marked as an action that cannot be undone, so ChatGPT asks before it posts anything. A batch is prepared first and shows real examples of the merged cards before you confirm it. A recurring rule is always created switched off, and reports how many people it can reach, so a person decides before it ever fires.

Requires a Scribble business account with credits.
payload.longDescription:
Scribble 会寄送真正的手写卡片。机器拿着真实的笔，用墨水书写每张卡片和信封，然后贴上邮票，寄往美国境内任何地方。所有内容都不是打印字体。

连接后，你可以让 ChatGPT 在通讯录中查找联系人、起草卡片并寄出；寄出前，它会展示一张卡片照片，照片采用实际将使用的笔迹，并同时显示印刷正面。你还可以查看各种笔迹样式，Scribble 会为每种样式写出真实样张。你也可以载入联系人电子表格，批量寄送个性化卡片（每张卡片写上不同姓名），并设置每年自动寄送生日贺卡的规则。

卡片使用预先在 scribblecards.com 购买的点数支付，因此此处不会收款，也不会链接到结账页面。寄送被标记为不可撤销的操作，所以 ChatGPT 在投递任何内容前都会征求确认。批次会先准备好，并在你确认前展示合并后卡片的真实示例。周期性规则创建时始终处于关闭状态，并会报告可覆盖的人数，让用户在规则真正触发前作出决定。

需要 Scribble 商业账户并预先购买点数。

payload.name: Gojiberry
payload.description: 寻找潜在客户并开展外联
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Gojiberry brings your outbound sales workflow into ChatGPT. Search a directory of B2B leads and companies with free masked previews, reveal full records, and enrich contacts with verified emails and mobile phone numbers. Organize contacts into lists, create and manage outreach campaigns, review campaign logs, configure lead-sourcing Agents, and read and reply to conversations in your unified inbox - all through natural language. Requires a Gojiberry account and API key from app.gojiberry.ai.
payload.longDescription: Gojiberry 将外向销售工作流程带入 ChatGPT。搜索 B2B 潜在客户和公司目录，可免费查看隐藏部分信息的预览；解锁完整记录，并通过经过验证的电子邮件地址和手机号码补全联系人信息。将联系人整理到列表中，创建和管理外联活动，查看活动日志，配置潜客挖掘 Agents，并通过统一收件箱阅读和回复对话——全部使用自然语言完成。需要 Gojiberry 账户，以及从 app.gojiberry.ai 获取的 API 密钥。

payload.name: FormEdge
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: FormEdge helps users create, edit, preview, and publish forms and landing pages, review submissions, manage notification settings, image assets, and saved page versions, and configure workspace settings — custom domains, the public URL subdomain, branding, and the language and time zone used for notification emails — through ChatGPT.
payload.longDescription: 通过 ChatGPT 使用 FormEdge 创建、编辑、预览和发布表单与落地页，查看提交内容，管理通知设置、图片素材和已保存的页面版本，并配置工作区设置——包括自定义域名、公开 URL 子域名、品牌，以及通知邮件使用的语言和时区。

payload.name: Flyweel
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Analyse your Google and Meta Ads campaigns with ChatGPT using the Flyweel MCP.
payload.longDescription: 通过 Flyweel MCP 使用 ChatGPT 分析 Google 和 Meta Ads 广告活动。

payload.name: Unthread
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Unthread is a B2B support platform for engineering and product teams. This plugin connects your Unthread workspace to ChatGPT through a compact, discovery-driven tool surface: search the underlying Unthread API, fetch schemas on demand, and run read or write operations gated by access class. Use it to investigate conversations, triage high-priority tickets, monitor SLAs and analytics, query your knowledge base, and create or update tickets.
payload.longDescription: Unthread 是面向工程和产品团队的 B2B 支持平台。此插件通过精简、以发现为导向的工具界面，将你的 Unthread 工作区连接到 ChatGPT：搜索底层 Unthread API、按需获取架构，并执行受访问类别权限控制的读写操作。可用于调查对话、分诊高优先级工单、监控 SLA 和分析数据、查询知识库，以及创建或更新工单。

payload.name: Clearskies
payload.summaryOriginal: AI you can trust with revenue
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Clearskies is the context layer for revenue AI. One connection turns your CRM, calls, email, calendar, Slack, and support tickets into a single, always-current picture of every account, so ChatGPT works across complete records instead of rebuilding context and guessing what matters. Get deep analysis like win/loss and rep performance, and run workflows like pre-call prep, CRM hygiene, and deal risk. Context assembled once is context every team, tool, and agent can reuse, and it improves as your data grows.
payload.longDescription: Clearskies 是营收 AI 的上下文层。只需建立一次连接，就能把 CRM、通话、邮件、日历、Slack 和支持工单整合成每个客户账户的单一实时全景，让 ChatGPT 基于完整记录开展工作，而无需重新拼凑上下文或猜测重点。获取深入分析，例如赢单/丢单情况和销售代表绩效；运行通话前准备、CRM 数据清理和交易风险评估等工作流程。一次汇集的上下文可供每个团队、工具和智能体重复使用，并会随着数据增长而不断完善。

payload.name: Nexoya
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Nexoya connects ChatGPT to a Nexoya workspace so marketers can ask natural-language questions about marketing portfolios, campaign or adset contents, funnel steps, labels, events, performance metrics, daily trends, regression-based attribution, and budget optimization recommendations. The app helps users summarize marketing performance, compare periods and channels, inspect ROI and ROAS, reason about trends, and explain the latest optimization proposal without leaving ChatGPT. Access is scoped to the signed-in user's Nexoya account and team permissions.
payload.longDescription: Nexoya 将 ChatGPT 连接到 Nexoya 工作区，让营销人员用自然语言询问营销组合、广告活动或广告组内容、漏斗步骤、标签、事件、表现指标、每日趋势、基于回归分析的归因，以及预算优化建议。该应用帮助用户总结营销表现、比较不同时期和渠道、查看 ROI 与 ROAS、分析趋势，并解释最新的优化方案，无需离开 ChatGPT。访问范围受已登录用户的 Nexoya 账户和团队权限限制。

payload.name: Civic Marketplace
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Civic Marketplace helps public agencies find cooperative contracts and suppliers, create and manage quote requests, and communicate with vendors. Suppliers can respond to opportunities and maintain their marketplace profiles.
payload.longDescription: Civic Marketplace 帮助公共机构寻找合作合同和供应商、创建和管理报价请求，并与供应商沟通。供应商可以回应机会并维护其市场资料。

payload.name: Lightbringer
payload.description: 在聊天中使用专利服务
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Lightbringer helps technology companies manage the patent process end to end, combining an AI-native platform with qualified patent attorneys on our team. Our service covers innovation capture, IP strategy, novelty and freedom-to-operate assessments, patent application drafting and filing, and prosecution through grant.

The Lightbringer plugin connects ChatGPT to your private organisation workspace. Capture innovations while working on technical solutions, find and enrich existing disclosures as your ideas develop, get automated feedback on clarity and completeness, and search and summarise innovations, patent documents and accessible meeting notes or transcripts. Find public patent publications, import your own portfolio or third-party references, and group saved own patents into families. Review, comment on, and respond to work with your Lightbringer patent team directly from the conversation.

Register an innovation to preserve and develop it, even before deciding how to protect it. When you decide to pursue a patent, separately request preparation for filing with Lightbringer. Automated description feedback and public patent discovery do not establish novelty, freedom to operate, current ownership or legal status. Attorney-led services are available through the Lightbringer team; the plugin supports the connected workflows described above.

Try questions like:
“Help me identify potential innovations in the solution we’ve been developing”
“Register this innovation without requesting patent preparation”
“Find our adaptive-fins disclosure and add what we learned today”
“Check this disclosure for gaps and help me prepare questions for our Lightbringer patent team”
“Show the reviews awaiting my response and help me act on them”
payload.longDescription:
Lightbringer 帮助科技公司端到端管理专利流程，将 AI 原生平台与团队中具备资质的专利律师结合起来。我们的服务涵盖创新提报、知识产权战略、新颖性和自由实施评估、专利申请撰写与提交，以及直至授权的审查答复流程。

Lightbringer 插件可将 ChatGPT 连接到你的私有组织工作区。在开发技术方案时记录创新；随着创意发展，查找并补充现有披露；获取有关清晰度和完整性的自动反馈；搜索并总结创新、专利文件以及可访问的会议笔记或转录文本。查找公开的专利公开文本，导入自己的专利组合或第三方参考资料，并将已保存的自有专利归入专利族。直接在对话中审阅、评论并回复 Lightbringer 专利团队的工作。

登记一项创新，以便保存并继续完善，即使你尚未决定如何保护它。决定申请专利后，再单独向 Lightbringer 请求准备申请材料。自动描述反馈和公开专利检索均不能确立新颖性、自由实施、当前所有权或法律状态。Lightbringer 团队可提供由律师主导的服务；该插件支持上述已连接的工作流。

可以尝试这样提问：
“帮我找出我们一直在开发的方案中可能存在的创新点”
“登记这项创新，但不要请求准备专利申请”
“找到我们的自适应鳍片披露，并补充今天的学习成果”
“检查这份披露是否有遗漏，并帮我准备向 Lightbringer 专利团队提出的问题”
“显示等待我回复的评审，并帮我处理”

payload.name: Appbot
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Appbot helps users inspect the apps tracked in their Appbot account, retrieve filtered app review pages, and summarize review counts, ratings, versions, and sentiment through ChatGPT.
payload.longDescription: Appbot 帮助用户通过 ChatGPT 查看 Appbot 账号中追踪的应用、检索筛选后的应用评价页面，并汇总评价数量、评分、版本和情绪。

payload.name: Clerky
payload.description: 处理你的股权资本表数据
payload.summaryOriginal: Work with your cap table data
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Bring your cap table data from Clerky into the conversation. Visualize ownership, model exits, and get instant answers without searching through paperwork. You can even combine your cap table data with your startup’s other tools. Just connect your Clerky account and choose which teams ChatGPT can access to get started.

This connection is read-only. ChatGPT can only retrieve information for teams you authorize and can’t start document sets or modify anything. Access runs through OAuth and can be disconnected at any time.
payload.longDescription:
将 Clerky 中的股权资本表数据带入对话。可视化所有权结构、模拟退出情景，无需翻找文书即可立即获得答案。你还可以将股权资本表数据与初创公司的其他工具结合使用。只需连接 Clerky 账户，并选择允许 ChatGPT 访问的团队即可开始。

此连接为只读。ChatGPT 只能检索你授权团队的信息，无法启动文件集或进行任何修改。访问通过 OAuth 进行，随时可以断开连接。

payload.name: Justworks
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Learn more about billing hours, payroll, insurance, and other information from Justworks platform via MCP
payload.longDescription: 通过 MCP 了解 Justworks 平台上的计费工时、工资发放、保险及其他信息。

payload.name: UMT-CAR Assistent
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
The UMT-CAR AI Assistant helps you quickly and easily get answers to all your car-related questions via chat.

Would you like to sell your car, calculate its online value, schedule a maintenance appointment, or view our current inventory? Just send us a message, and our assistant will help you right away.

Key features:

List your car for sale
Calculate your vehicle's online value
Schedule a maintenance appointment
View current inventory
Send contact and information requests
Chat quickly and easily

Ontdek meer via umtcar.be.
payload.longDescription:
UMT-CAR AI 助手通过聊天，帮助你快速、轻松地解答所有汽车相关问题。

想卖车、计算车辆的线上估值、预约保养，还是查看我们的当前库存？给我们发消息，助手会立即为你提供帮助。

主要功能：

发布售车信息
计算车辆线上估值
预约保养
查看当前库存
发送联系及信息咨询
快速便捷地聊天

通过 umtcar.be 了解更多。

payload.name: LawVu
payload.description: 企业法务团队的操作系统
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
LawVu is the legal operating system for in-house corporate legal teams, combining matter management, contract lifecycle management, spend, intake, documents, and a knowledge base in one unified platform.

Connect ChatGPT to the operational data your legal team relies on every day. Search and retrieve matters and contracts in natural language, generate status summaries and reports, retrieve answers grounded in your internal legal knowledge base, create new matters or intake requests, update matter status, and create tasks - all without leaving ChatGPT. 

You can also combine LawVu data with information from other connected systems, like CRM or HR platforms, for cross-system reporting and analysis.

Access is scoped to each user's own permissions and record access in LawVu and provides a full audit trail.
payload.longDescription:
LawVu 是面向企业内部法务团队的法律运营系统，将事项管理、合同生命周期管理、支出、需求受理、文档和知识库整合到一个统一平台。

将 ChatGPT 连接到法务团队日常依赖的运营数据。你可以使用自然语言搜索和检索事项及合同、生成状态摘要和报告、获取基于内部法律知识库的回答、创建事项或受理请求、更新事项状态并创建任务——全程无需离开 ChatGPT。

你还可以将 LawVu 数据与 CRM 或 HR 平台等其他已连接系统的信息结合，用于跨系统报告和分析。

访问范围遵循每位用户在 LawVu 中的权限和记录访问权限，并提供完整审计跟踪。

payload.name: Coevera
payload.description: 管理 Coevera CRM 数据
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Connect ChatGPT to your Coevera (formerly Pipeliner CRM) and work with your sales data conversationally. Search accounts, contacts, leads, opportunities, tasks, and appointments using natural-language queries, then create follow-up tasks or update deal stages directly from chat. The server supports standard fields, custom fields, and custom entities, with filters for precise queries. Useful for sales reps preparing for calls, managers reviewing pipeline health, and ops teams running ad-hoc reports without exporting to CSV.
payload.longDescription: 将 ChatGPT 连接到你的 Coevera（前身为 Pipeliner CRM），以对话方式处理销售数据。使用自然语言查询搜索客户账户、联系人、潜在客户、商机、任务和预约，然后直接在聊天中创建跟进任务或更新交易阶段。服务器支持标准字段、自定义字段和自定义实体，并提供用于精准查询的筛选条件。适合销售代表为通话做准备、经理检查销售管道健康状况，以及运营团队无需导出 CSV 即可运行临时报告。

payload.name: Partner.io
payload.description: 运行你的合作伙伴计划
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Manage your Partner.io program without opening a single tab. Add partners, log and update leads, record payments, create rewards, and build program tiers — just by asking. Your AI assistant works directly with your live Partner.io account, so every change lands exactly where your team already works.
payload.longDescription: 无需打开任何标签页即可管理 Partner.io 计划。只需提出请求，就能添加合作伙伴、记录和更新潜在客户、记录付款、创建奖励并构建计划层级。AI 助手直接使用实时 Partner.io 账户，每项变更都会准确落到团队现有的工作环境中。

payload.name: Velaris Basic
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Velaris Basic lets you access your customer data directly from ChatGPT, using plain language — no dashboards, no switching tabs.

What you can do:

Look up accounts and organizations — check health scores, churn status, ARR, lifecycle stage, and assigned CSM for any customer.
Search contacts — find individuals by name, account, or role and review their details.
Track risks and opportunities — surface at-risk accounts or open expansion opportunities across your book of business.
Manage notes and tasks — read existing notes, create new ones, and update tasks tied to customer records.
Who it's for:
Customer Success Managers and CS leaders who want a faster way to access and update their Velaris data without leaving their workflow.

Requires a Velaris account. Read and write access is governed by your Velaris role permissions.
payload.longDescription:
Velaris Basic 让你可以直接在 ChatGPT 中用日常语言访问客户数据，无需仪表板，也无需切换标签页。

你可以：

查询客户账户和组织——查看任意客户的健康评分、流失状态、ARR、生命周期阶段和分配的 CSM。
搜索联系人——按姓名、账户或角色查找人员并查看其详情。
跟踪风险和机会——在你的客户组合中发现有风险的账户或待处理的扩展机会。
管理笔记和任务——阅读现有笔记、创建新笔记，并更新关联客户记录的任务。
适用对象：
希望无需离开现有工作流程，就能更快访问和更新 Velaris 数据的客户成功经理和客户成功领导者。

需要 Velaris 账户。读写权限由你的 Velaris 角色权限控制。

payload.name: 4Degrees
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: 4Degrees brings your relationship intelligence and deal flow into ChatGPT. Ask about your contacts, companies, and deals in plain English — "who's my warmest path to a CTO at Stripe?", "show me Series B deals by stage", "what needs my attention today?". You can also update your CRM — add tags, log notes, and move deal stages — with a preview-and-confirm step on every change and one-tap undo. Scoped per-teammate via OAuth to the data and permissions your seat already has. Designed for private-markets investors, M&A teams, and search funds.
payload.longDescription: 4Degrees将你的人脉情报和交易项目流带入ChatGPT。用日常英语询问联系人、公司和交易，例如“谁最适合帮我引荐Stripe的CTO？”“按阶段显示B轮交易”“今天有什么需要我关注？”你也可以更新CRM：添加标签、记录笔记、调整交易阶段；每项更改都设有预览和确认步骤，并可一键撤销。通过OAuth按团队成员限定范围，仅访问你的席位已有的数据与权限。专为私募市场投资者、并购团队和搜索基金设计。

payload.name: SEO with Distribb
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
SEO articles & backlinks for your website, run from ChatGPT. Connect your Distribb account and you can research keywords with real search volume and difficulty data, plan a content calendar, write SEO articles, and publish them straight to WordPress, Webflow, Shopify, Wix, Framer, Ghost or Notion without leaving the chat.

SEO reporting is built in. Check how pages are performing in Google Search Console, see which backlinks your site has earned through Distribb's exchange, and track how often AI assistants cite your brand. You can also edit posts that are already live and push the changes back to your site, and reply to Google Business Profile reviews.

It is built for founders, marketers, agencies and content teams who would rather describe what they want than click through a dashboard. You need a Distribb account at distribb.io, and every tool works only against your own projects.
payload.longDescription:
在 ChatGPT 中为你的网站创建 SEO 文章并获取反向链接。连接 Distribb 账户后，你可以根据真实搜索量和难度数据研究关键词、规划内容日历、撰写 SEO 文章，并直接发布到 WordPress、Webflow、Shopify、Wix、Framer、Ghost 或 Notion，无需离开聊天。

内置 SEO 报告功能。查看页面在 Google Search Console 中的表现、了解网站通过 Distribb 交换获得了哪些反向链接，并追踪 AI 助手引用你品牌的频率。你还可以编辑已上线的文章并将修改推送回网站，也可以回复 Google Business Profile 评价。

它面向创始人、营销人员、代理机构和内容团队，让他们描述需求即可操作，无需逐项点击仪表板。你需要拥有 distribb.io 上的 Distribb 账户，且每项工具只会处理你自己的项目。

payload.name: Ninjo
payload.description: 管理 AI 互动代理
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Ninjo helps operators run their AI engagement agents in plain language: diagnose an agent's setup and get prioritized fixes, review the conversations it handled, edit prompts and triggers, audit the contact limits, follow-up workflows and notifications wired around it, and segment the contact directory by custom-property values.
payload.longDescription: Ninjo 帮助运营人员用日常语言管理 AI 互动代理：诊断代理配置并获取优先级修复建议，查看代理处理过的对话，编辑提示词和触发条件，审查联系人限制、后续跟进工作流及相关通知，并按自定义属性值细分联系人目录。

payload.name: Badger Maps (Advanced)
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Badger Maps is the #1 field sales platform.

Badger AI brings a new layer of intelligence to the platform your team already uses. Opt into the features that make sense for your workflow — from AI-built routes to automated CRM updates — and let Badger handle the busy work so your reps can spend more time selling.

AI Route Planner: Your optimal week, built automatically
Stop deciding who to see and when. Badger AI analyzes your accounts and builds your entire week automatically — prioritizing your stops by last visit date, follow-up status, and opportunity size, all built around the existing meetings in your calendar.

Automated Follow-Up Emails: No deal goes cold. No follow-up gets missed.
Deals die in the silence between meetings. Badger AI reads your meeting notes and automatically drafts and sends personalized follow-up emails to every customer — so the right message goes to the right person at the right time, without you lifting a finger.

Automated Scheduling Emails: Scheduling, without the back and forth
Before you even leave for the field, Badger AI analyzes your routes and sends targeted email blasts to prospects in the areas you're visiting — so by the time you're on the road, meetings are already being set up around your existing schedule.

The old way of field sales is over.
Reps planning routes by hand. Hours of admin after a long day in the field. Follow-ups that fall through the cracks. Badger AI eliminates all of it — so your team can focus on what actually moves the needle.

The future of field sales is automated. Start today.
payload.longDescription:
Badger Maps 是排名 #1 的外勤销售平台。

Badger AI 为团队已经使用的平台增添智能能力。按需启用适合工作流程的功能，从 AI 规划路线到自动更新 CRM，让 Badger 处理繁杂事务，让销售代表有更多时间开展销售。

AI 路线规划器：自动安排你的最佳一周
无需再决定拜访谁、何时拜访。Badger AI 分析你的客户账户，自动规划整周行程，根据上次拜访日期、跟进状态和商机规模安排拜访优先级，并围绕日历中现有会议进行规划。

自动跟进邮件：不让交易冷却，不遗漏任何跟进。
会议之间的沉默会让交易告吹。Badger AI 读取会议记录，自动为每位客户起草并发送个性化跟进邮件，让正确的信息在正确的时间送达正确的人，无需你动手。

自动预约邮件：无需反复沟通即可安排日程
在你出发开展外勤之前，Badger AI 就会分析路线，向计划拜访区域内的潜在客户发送有针对性的群发邮件。因此，当你上路时，会议已开始围绕现有日程安排。

传统外勤销售方式已经结束。
销售代表手工规划路线，在漫长外勤日结束后花数小时处理行政事务，跟进事项被遗漏。Badger AI 消除所有这些问题，让团队专注于真正带来成效的工作。

外勤销售的未来是自动化。今天就开始。

payload.name: Intellistrata
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Intellistrata connects ChatGPT with the Intellistrata strata management platform, allowing authorised users to securely access and work with information relating to the properties and owners corporations they manage.

Depending on the user’s Intellistrata permissions and the tools enabled for their organisation, the plugin can help users locate property, lot, owner, financial, task, maintenance, document and other strata management information. It may also support approved operational workflows through conversational requests.

Access is restricted to authenticated Intellistrata users and is governed by the permissions configured for their organisation and account. Users can only access information and perform actions they are authorised to access within Intellistrata. Important financial, legal, property and administrative information should be reviewed and confirmed by an authorised user before it is relied upon.
payload.longDescription:
Intellistrata 将 ChatGPT 连接到 Intellistrata 分层物业管理平台，让获授权用户安全访问并处理其所管理物业及业主法人团体相关信息。

根据用户在 Intellistrata 中的权限以及组织启用的工具，插件可帮助查找物业、地块、业主、财务、任务、维护、文档和其他分层物业管理信息。它也可能支持通过对话请求执行获批的运营工作流。

访问仅限经过身份验证的 Intellistrata 用户，并受其组织和账户配置的权限约束。用户只能访问其在 Intellistrata 中获准访问的信息并执行获准的操作。重要的财务、法律、物业和行政信息在依赖之前，应由获授权用户审核并确认。

payload.name: Tariff Code Compliance
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Tariff Code Compliance helps users discover current tariff systems, research classification nodes and evidence, compare alternatives, and prepare a session-local product classification recommendation.
payload.longDescription: Tariff Code Compliance 帮助用户查找现行关税体系、研究分类节点及其证据、比较备选项，并生成仅在当前会话中有效的产品分类建议。

payload.name: Spacebring
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Spacebring connects ChatGPT to your coworking space management platform, giving you instant access to your business' operational data for reporting, member support, and day-to-day decision-making.

Spacebring helps coworking space operators deliver superior member service through automated operations, built-in AI, and an admin mobile app. The platform helps operators serve customers faster, reduce admin chores, and streamline operations, while delivering a seamless branded customer experience to sign up, book, pay, and get support with ease.

This plugin lets ChatGPT query your live Spacebring data directly in conversation, so you can ask questions, get answers without switching tools or building reports manually.

Key features:
• Pull details on your network and every location you operate, including configuration and status.
•  Look up members and companies in your network, including their details and account status.
•  Access contracts and the templates behind them, useful for audits, renewals, and legal review.
•  Review active subscriptions and the membership plans tied to them.
•  Retrieve invoice records for billing checks, reconciliation, and reporting.
•  Query benefit categories, individual benefits, and member benefit applications.
•  Look up shop categories, products, and orders for on-site retail or add-on services.
•  Access member-facing guides and resources published in your network.

This plugin is read-only today: it's built for retrieving and analyzing data, not making changes to your Spacebring account. Future updates will expand coverage further and eventually support write actions (like updating records or triggering workflows) directly from ChatGPT.

Built by the Spacebring team for the Spacebring family.
payload.longDescription:
Spacebring 将 ChatGPT 连接到你的共享办公空间管理平台，让你即时获取业务运营数据，用于报告、会员支持和日常决策。

Spacebring 帮助共享办公空间运营商通过自动化运营、内置 AI 和管理员移动应用提供更优质的会员服务。平台帮助运营商更快服务客户、减少行政杂务并简化运营，同时为客户提供顺畅且具有品牌特色的注册、预订、付款和支持体验。

此插件让 ChatGPT 能够在对话中直接查询你的实时 Spacebring 数据，因此你可以直接提问并获取答案，无需切换工具或手动制作报告。

主要功能：
• 获取你的网络和所运营各个地点的详细信息，包括配置和状态。
• 查询网络中的会员和公司，包括其详情和账户状态。
• 访问合同及其模板，便于审计、续约和法律审核。
• 查看有效订阅及其对应的会员计划。
• 获取发票记录，用于账单核查、对账和报告。
• 查询权益类别、具体权益和会员权益申请。
• 查询店铺类别、商品和订单，用于现场零售或附加服务。
• 访问在你的网络中发布、面向会员的指南和资源。

此插件目前为只读：用于检索和分析数据，不会更改你的 Spacebring 账户。未来更新将进一步扩大覆盖范围，并最终支持直接通过 ChatGPT 更新记录或触发工作流等写入操作。

由 Spacebring 团队为 Spacebring 社区打造。

payload.name: Adthena
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Connect to the Adthena competitive intelligence platform to analyze paid search markets, monitor competitors, and uncover search opportunities directly inside ChatGPT.

Explore market share trends, compare advertiser visibility, discover high-value search terms, analyze ad copy strategies, track AI Overview presence, and detect potential trademark infringements using natural language queries.

Ask questions like “Who is gaining market share in running shoes?”, “What ad copy themes are competitors using?”, or “Which search terms are driving growth in this category?” and receive structured, data-driven insights instantly.

The app provides authoritative competitive search intelligence across market analysis, search optimization, brand protection, and AI search visibility. Requires an active Adthena subscription and authenticates securely via OAuth using your existing Adthena credentials.
payload.longDescription:
连接 Adthena 竞争情报平台，直接在 ChatGPT 内分析付费搜索市场、监测竞争对手并发现搜索机会。

通过自然语言查询，探索市场份额趋势、比较广告主曝光度、发现高价值搜索词、分析广告文案策略、追踪 AI Overview 中的出现情况，并发现潜在商标侵权。

提出“谁在跑鞋市场获得更多份额？”、“竞争对手使用哪些广告文案主题？”或“哪些搜索词正在推动该品类增长？”等问题，即时获取结构化、数据驱动的洞见。

应用提供权威的竞争搜索情报，涵盖市场分析、搜索优化、品牌保护和 AI 搜索曝光度。需要有效的 Adthena 订阅，并使用现有 Adthena 凭据通过 OAuth 安全认证。

payload.name: Strella
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Browse, analyze, and create user research studies directly from ChatGPT. Make Strella native to your AI workflow — the customer research platform that uses AI to run in-depth interviews and generate actionable insights.
payload.longDescription: 直接在 ChatGPT 中浏览、分析并创建用户研究。让 Strella 融入你的 AI 工作流——这是一个利用 AI 开展深度访谈并生成可执行洞察的客户调研平台。

payload.name: Listen Labs
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Browse your Listen Labs studies, pull response data, review study designs, and surface analysis insights, all without leaving your workflow. Create, edit, and launch new user research studies directly from ChatGPT. payload.longDescription: 浏览你的 Listen Labs 研究、提取回答数据、查看研究设计并发现分析洞察，全程无需离开工作流。直接在 ChatGPT 中创建、编辑和启动新的用户研究。无论你开展的是市场探索、产品发现、可用性测试还是假设验证，Listen Labs 都会成为研究流程中的原生组成部分：由 AI 驱动的助手，帮助你更快综合定性发现并获得更深入的洞察。

payload.name: Scribe
payload.description: 管理公司电子邮件签名
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Scribe is email signature management for enterprise: IT sets it up once, marketing runs it, and no employee ever installs anything.

Connect Scribe to ChatGPT and manage your workspace in plain language:

• Create, edit, preview and publish signature templates
• Assign signatures to teammates, groups and folders
• Manage smart fields, assets and integrations
• Launch, schedule and pause banner campaigns
• Pull view, click and conversion analytics

Signatures deploy centrally across Google Workspace, Microsoft 365 and 30+ tools. Sign in with your Scribe account via OAuth — the app forwards your own access token and never stores an API key.
payload.longDescription:
Scribe 是面向企业的电子邮件签名管理工具：IT 部门只需设置一次，之后由营销团队管理，员工无需安装任何东西。

将 Scribe 连接到 ChatGPT，即可用自然语言管理工作区：

• 创建、编辑、预览和发布签名模板
• 为队友、群组和文件夹分配签名
• 管理智能字段、素材和集成
• 启动、安排和暂停横幅活动
• 获取浏览量、点击量和转化率分析

签名可通过 Google Workspace、Microsoft 365 和 30+ 种工具集中部署。使用 Scribe 账户通过 OAuth 登录后，应用会转发你自己的访问令牌，并且绝不存储 API 密钥。

payload.name: Campaign Requirement Extractor
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Campaign Requirement Extractor extracts structured campaign requirement fields from campaign request text. It returns campaign name, objective, channel, budget, deadline, missing fields, source text, and errors. It does not design campaign strategy, judge budget reasonableness, write marketing copy, recommend channels, publish, schedule, send messages, update systems, or take operational actions. The app is read-only, stateless, uses no external APIs, stores no data, and only processes the submitted text for the current request.
payload.longDescription: Campaign Requirement Extractor 从营销活动请求文本中提取结构化需求字段。它返回活动名称、目标、渠道、预算、截止日期、缺失字段、源文本和错误。它不会设计活动策略、判断预算是否合理、撰写营销文案、推荐渠道、发布、排程、发送消息、更新系统或执行运营操作。此应用只读、无状态、不使用外部 API、不存储数据，只处理当前请求中提交的文本。

payload.name: LevelUp
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Connect your LevelUp account to manage your real estate CRM, follow-up tasks, pipeline deals, open houses, brand assets, training, and authorized Listing Exchange content from ChatGPT.
payload.longDescription: 连接 LevelUp 账户后，即可在 ChatGPT 中管理房地产 CRM、跟进任务、销售管线交易、开放日活动、品牌素材、培训内容，以及获授权的 Listing Exchange 内容。

payload.name: Wialon Platform

payload.name: Presuo
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Presuo helps users browse their own construction budgets in ChatGPT, navigate work sections and budget items, inspect quantity items, and run budget-scoped search.
payload.longDescription: Presuo 可帮助用户在 ChatGPT 中浏览自己的施工预算、查看工程分项和预算项目、检查工程量项目，并在预算范围内进行搜索。

payload.name: Nike
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
If you have a body, you're an athlete. And if you're a runner, you need the right shoes. This tool is designed to help runners find the fit, feel, and footwear style they need to get the most out of the run.

All product has been obsessed by runners and engineered to the exact specifications of championship athletes.
payload.longDescription:
只要你有身体，你就是运动员。如果你是跑者，就需要合适的跑鞋。此工具旨在帮助跑者找到合适的贴合感、脚感和鞋款风格，充分发挥跑步表现。

所有产品均由跑者投入心力打造，并按照冠军运动员的精确要求进行设计。

payload.name: Windsor.ai TikTok Ads
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Windsor.ai TikTok Ads connects your TikTok Ads data to your AI assistant, so you can analyze performance and manage campaigns in plain English. Discover connected ad accounts, inspect valid fields and options, and query campaign, ad group, and ad metrics (spend, impressions, clicks, CTR, CPC, and conversions) over any date range. On confirmation, it can also pause or enable campaigns, ad groups, and ads and set campaign and ad group budgets.

Common workflows:
- Compare spend, clicks, and conversions by campaign for the last 30 days
- Find an underperforming ad group and pause it, after you confirm
- Adjust a campaign budget without leaving the conversation

Changes to your account are made only after you confirm the specific action; everything else is read-only. Free plan available, no credit card required.

Windsor.ai is an independent product and is not affiliated with or endorsed by the platforms it connects to.
payload.longDescription:
Windsor.ai TikTok Ads 将你的 TikTok Ads 数据连接到 AI 助手，让你用简单的英语分析表现并管理营销活动。发现已连接的广告账户，查看有效字段和选项，并按任意日期范围查询营销活动、广告组和广告指标（支出、展示次数、点击次数、CTR、CPC 和转化次数）。经确认后，还可以暂停或启用营销活动、广告组和广告，并设置营销活动和广告组预算。

常见工作流程：
- 比较过去 30 days 各营销活动的支出、点击量和转化量
- 找出表现不佳的广告组，并在你确认后将其暂停
- 无需离开对话即可调整营销活动预算

只有在你确认具体操作后，才会更改账户；其余操作均为只读。提供免费套餐，无需信用卡。

Windsor.ai 是独立产品，与其连接的平台没有关联，也未获其认可。

payload.name: XAPP Analyst
payload.description: 随时对话的数据分析师
payload.summaryOriginal: An analyst you can talk to
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: XAPP Analyst is an agent you can talk to about your leads, bookings, and customer conversations, right inside ChatGPT. Ask in plain language to break down leads by location and referring source, find the sources driving your most high‑value leads, and spot trends by service type and urgency. Pull the full detail on any recent lead, surface the homeowner phrases that can sharpen your SEO and search ads, review business and location context, and compare your business against nearby competitors. It help you learn about your business from your data and act on those learnings.
payload.longDescription: XAPP Analyst 是一款可在 ChatGPT 中直接对话的智能助手，用于分析潜在客户、预订和客户沟通。用日常语言提问，即可按地点和引荐来源拆解潜在客户，找出带来高价值线索的来源，并发现按服务类型和紧急程度划分的趋势。调取近期任一线索的完整详情，提取可用于改进 SEO 和搜索广告的房主用语，查看业务和地点背景，并与附近竞争者比较。它能帮助你从自身数据中了解业务，并据此采取行动。

payload.name: Quotient
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Quotient is an AI-native platform and intelligent agent in one; built to plan and execute campaigns across email, social, blog, and events, without the fragmented tools you've outgrown.

At its core, Quotient is an AI demand marketing platform. It brings everything that attracts customers: blogs, social posts, email, webinars and events, and brand-building, into one integrated workspace. You work with Quotient like a coworker. Describe what you want in plain English, and it takes it from there.

Campaigns organize your marketing around a central goal, like a feature launch or event. Each is a coordinated set of tasks and deliverables moving through a clear workflow. Deliverables are the real assets Quotient creates and ships: blog posts, email broadcasts, marketing events, automated flows, and social posts for X, LinkedIn, Instagram, Facebook, and TikTok. Ask Quotient to build a campaign end to end: it writes the brief, breaks the work into tasks, sets the timeline, and produces each deliverable.

Quotient gets smarter over time, drawing on a Knowledge Store of brand information, recording memories of your preferences, and using tools to search the web and pull from your audience of people and companies.

The result is a single platform where strategy, content, and execution live together, replacing the patchwork of disconnected marketing tools with one AI that plans, writes, and ships.

payload.name: Fresenius Medical Care Careers
payload.description: 查找 Fresenius Medical 的职位
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
The Fresenius Medical Care Careers app helps you discover job opportunities at Fresenius
Medical Care in one place. 

Instead of browsing multiple pages, you can search for roles by job title, specialty, or location and quickly
explore available opportunities across the organization. The app makes it easy to understand what each role involves and identify positions that match your experience and interests. The app is designed to simplify career exploration within Fresenius Medical Care. 

Whether you’re actively applying or just learning about opportunities, it helps you navigate openings without complexity. When you find a role that interests you, you can review the job details and proceed to the official application process.

Key features
• Search jobs by title, specialty, or location
• Explore opportunities across Fresenius Medical Care
• View role details and requirements in one place
• Access official employment application pages for each role
payload.longDescription:
Fresenius Medical Care Careers 应用可帮助你集中查找 Fresenius Medical Care 的工作机会。

无需逐页浏览，你可以按职位名称、专业领域或地点搜索，快速查看整个组织提供的机会。应用会介绍各职位的工作内容，帮助你找到符合自身经验和兴趣的岗位，简化在 Fresenius Medical Care 的职业机会探索。

无论你正在积极求职，还是只是了解有哪些机会，都可以轻松浏览职位空缺。找到感兴趣的岗位后，可查看职位详情并前往官方申请流程。

主要功能
• 按职位名称、专业领域或地点搜索工作
• 浏览 Fresenius Medical Care 的职位机会
• 在一处查看职位详情和要求
• 访问各职位的官方求职申请页面

payload.name: Velaris Intelligence

Velaris Intelligence connects to your Velaris data to generate 
ready-to-use customer success reports on demand. 
Built for Customer Success Managers who want faster prep without 
switching between tools. Sign in with your Velaris account to get 
started.

专为希望加快准备工作、无需在工具之间切换的客户成功经理打造。使用你的 Velaris 账户登录即可开始。

payload.name: Buildfire
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Buildfire helps app owners manage their Buildfire apps from ChatGPT. payload.name: Nashville Real Estate AI
payload.description: 为房地产经纪人节省时间
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Nashville Real Estate AI helps real estate agents create professional listing descriptions, client emails, social media content, market updates, open house follow-up sequences, neighborhood spotlights, objection responses, and investment analysis — all from a single conversation. Describe your property, name your client, or pick an objection, and get polished, ready-to-use content instantly.
payload.longDescription: Nashville Real Estate AI 帮助房地产经纪人在一次对话中创建专业的房源描述、客户邮件、社交媒体内容、市场更新、开放日跟进序列、社区介绍、异议回复和投资分析。描述房产、说出客户姓名或选择一个异议，即可即时获得润色完成、可直接使用的内容。

payload.name: Ribbon
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Manage your candidate pipeline and applicants using Ribbon. Connect your ATS (Workday, Ashby, Lever, Greenhouse, and 40+ different platforms) to Ribbon and manage your open roles, candidates, and applications from ChatGPT with the power of Ribbon's ChatGPT app.
payload.longDescription: 使用 Ribbon 管理候选人流程和申请者。将你的 ATS（Workday、Ashby、Lever、Greenhouse 以及 40+ 个不同平台）连接到 Ribbon，即可通过 Ribbon 的 ChatGPT 应用在 ChatGPT 中管理开放职位、候选人和申请。

payload.name: Fritto Time Tracker
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: A time tracking tool for teams. Log daily work hours against projects and clients, submit timesheets for approval and generate reports. Managers can review, approve or reject entries and lock past periods. Supports multi-tenant setups for agencies and companies with multiple teams.
payload.longDescription: 面向团队的工时追踪工具。按项目和客户记录每日工时，提交工时表以供审批，并生成报告。经理可以审核、批准或拒绝记录，也可以锁定过去的统计周期。支持服务机构和拥有多个团队的公司采用多租户配置。

payload.name: Magnetly
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Magnetly helps you create interactive lead generation tools powered by AI.

Instead of static PDFs, you can build quizzes, calculators, and generators that deliver personalized results to your audience. These tools engage visitors, capture leads automatically, and improve conversion rates.

With Magnetly, you can:

- Turn ideas into interactive lead magnets
- Generate personalized outputs using AI
- Customize design to match your brand
- Capture and sync leads with your CRM

It’s designed for marketers, agencies, and founders who want to turn website traffic into qualified leads using simple, no-code tools.
payload.longDescription:
Magnetly 帮助你创建由 AI 驱动的互动式获客工具。

你可以创建测验、计算器和生成器，向受众提供个性化结果，而不是使用静态 PDF。这些工具能吸引访客、自动收集潜客并提高转化率。

它面向希望通过简单的无代码工具，把网站流量转化为合格潜客的营销人员、机构和创始人。

payload.name: CalcForms

payload.longDescription: CalcForms 可将工作簿规格或自然语言描述转换为可计算的表单，让用户测试并发布表单，还提供私密仪表盘，用于管理提交内容、邀请、导出和账户设置。

payload.name: ZINT
payload.description: 经核实的英国企业数据
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: ZINT gives ChatGPT verified UK corporate intelligence for prospecting, M&A and restructuring research, investment analysis, and risk and compliance monitoring. Grounded in Companies House records and enriched with news, annual accounts and website signals, the app resolves free-text company names or domains to authoritative UK identifiers, searches the UK company database with structured financial, governance, sector, region and event-driven filters, retrieves selected company data fields, surfaces recent news by event category, previews annual accounts sections, fetches categorised website content, and checks the user's ZINT credit balance.
payload.longDescription: ZINT 为 ChatGPT 提供经过核实的英国企业情报，可用于潜在客户开发、并购和重组研究、投资分析以及风险与合规监测。该应用以 Companies House 记录为依据，并结合新闻、年度账目和网站信号进行丰富；可将自由输入的公司名称或域名匹配到权威的英国标识符，使用结构化财务、治理、行业、地区和事件筛选条件搜索英国企业数据库，检索选定的公司数据字段，按事件类别显示近期新闻，预览年度账目章节，获取分类的网站内容，并查看用户的 ZINT 额度余额。

payload.name: Anagram
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Anagram lets teams analyze Site Agent user conversations, engagement, and business impact in ChatGPT. It can find and read conversations, report activity and outcomes, and run project-scoped, read-only analytics queries.
payload.longDescription: Anagram 让团队在 ChatGPT 中分析 Site Agent 用户对话、参与情况和业务影响。它可以查找和读取对话、报告活动及结果，并运行范围限于项目的只读分析查询。

payload.name: APiM Galaxy
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: APiM Galaxy is an MCP (Model Context Protocol) server, built by A Piece of Map Inc., that adds business-development and market-entry research to the AI you already use — ChatGPT, Claude, or Claude Code. You name a company you want to reach or a market you want to enter, and the connector maps who they actually work with, finds the warmest introduction path, and returns a prioritized plan — with every relationship checked against its source, and unverified ties flagged. The full research is free, with no usage limit. With an existing APiM Galaxy Pro account signed in, the same run also delivers a branded report page with a one-click PDF and a saved company profile. Learn more at galaxy.apieceofmap.com/connector.
payload.longDescription: APiM Galaxy是由A Piece of Map Inc.打造的MCP（Model Context Protocol，模型上下文协议）服务器，为你已在使用的AI——ChatGPT、Claude或Claude Code——添加业务拓展和市场进入研究功能。说出你希望接触的公司或希望进入的市场，连接器就会梳理它们实际合作的对象、寻找最容易获得熟人引荐的路径，并返回按优先级排列的计划；每项关系都会对照来源核验，未经验证的关系会被标记。完整研究免费，且没有使用次数限制。登录现有APiM Galaxy Pro账户后，同一次运行还会提供带品牌标识的报告页面，支持一键获取PDF并保存公司资料。更多信息请见galaxy.apieceofmap.com/connector。

payload.name: Posthive
payload.description: 向多个社交平台发布内容
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Posthive lets you schedule and publish social media posts across 13 platforms — Bluesky, Threads, Instagram, LinkedIn, Mastodon, YouTube, Facebook Pages, Pinterest, Telegram, Nostr, X (Twitter), Discord, Tumblr and more all from one place.

Ask ChatGPT to draft a post, pick your accounts, and schedule it for the right time. You can create drafts for human review, approve and schedule them, update or reschedule pending posts, and manage post templates. Everything stays in your Posthive queue so nothing publishes without your control.
payload.longDescription:
Posthive 可让您在 13 个平台安排并发布社交媒体帖子——包括 Bluesky、Threads、Instagram、LinkedIn、Mastodon、YouTube、Facebook Pages、Pinterest、Telegram、Nostr、X (Twitter)、Discord、Tumblr 等，所有操作都可在一处完成。

payload.name: Wingz by Wingify
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Wingz helps teams analyze experimentation performance, review behavior insights, and manage testing campaigns directly from ChatGPT.
payload.longDescription: Wingz 帮助团队直接通过 ChatGPT 分析实验表现、查看行为洞察并管理测试营销活动。

payload.name: SalesBreaker GTM
payload.description: 安全地操作销售工作区
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: SalesBreaker GTM lets ChatGPT operate the user's SalesBreaker workspace for internal CRM updates, collection management, task creation, template drafts, LP/proposal drafts, CSV staging, and sales preparation. It cannot send outreach, submit forms, execute campaigns or workflows, publish pages, export databases, change billing/authentication, operate infrastructure, or delete records.
payload.longDescription: SalesBreaker GTM 允许 ChatGPT 操作用户的 SalesBreaker 工作区，用于内部 CRM 更新、集合管理、创建任务、起草模板、LP/提案草稿、CSV 暂存和销售准备。它不能发送拓展消息、提交表单、执行营销活动或工作流、发布页面、导出数据库、更改账单/身份验证、操作基础设施或删除记录。

payload.name: Menu Integrado
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Menu Integrado helps business managers better understand their operations through secure, read-only access to their data. Analyze orders, sales, channels, delivery methods, financial transactions, fiscal documents, products, catalog details, technical sheets, and sales history.

The app supports multiple locations, allowing users to query each location individually, compare periods, and combine information to understand performance and identify opportunities for improvement.
payload.longDescription:
Menu Integrado 通过安全的只读数据访问，帮助企业管理者更好地了解运营。分析订单、销售、渠道、配送方式、财务交易、税务文件、产品、目录详情、技术表和销售历史。

该应用支持多个地点，用户可以逐个查询每个地点、比较不同期间，并合并信息来了解表现和发现改进机会。

payload.name: Windsor.ai GBP
payload.description: 读取 Google 商家资料
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Windsor.ai Google Business Profile connects your Google Business Profile data to your AI assistant, so you can analyze local performance and manage your listing in plain English. Discover connected locations, inspect valid fields and options, and query views, searches, calls, direction requests, and review metrics over any date range. On confirmation, it can also publish or update posts, reply to reviews, upload photos, update business info, and set regular, special, or open and closed hours.

Common workflows:
- See how customers found your business in the last 30 days
- Reply to a recent review, after you confirm the wording
- Publish a post or update your opening hours

Changes to your listing are made only after you confirm the specific action; everything else is read-only. Free plan available, no credit card required.

Windsor.ai is an independent product and is not affiliated with or endorsed by the platforms it connects to.
payload.longDescription:
Windsor.ai Google Business Profile 将你的 Google 商家资料数据连接到 AI 助手，让你用通俗语言分析本地成效并管理商家信息。发现已连接的地点，查看有效字段和选项，并查询任意日期范围内的浏览、搜索、来电、路线请求和评论指标。经确认后，还可发布或更新帖子、回复评论、上传照片、更新商家信息，以及设置常规、特殊或营业/歇业时间。

常见工作流：
- 查看过去 30 天顾客如何找到你的商家
- 确认回复内容后，回复近期评论
- 发布帖子或更新营业时间

只有在你确认具体操作后，才会更改商家资料；其他所有功能均为只读。提供免费套餐，无需信用卡。

Windsor.ai 是独立产品，与其连接的平台没有关联，也未获其认可。

payload.name: Bynn
payload.description: 检测图像和 PDF 中的欺诈
payload.summaryOriginal: Detect Fraud in Images and PDF
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Detect signs of fraud, manipulation, and AI generation in images and PDF documents. Upload a file and the app analyzes it for authenticity signals such as possible edits, synthetic content, document tampering, and AI-generated visuals.

It helps teams quickly review suspicious images, identity documents, invoices, statements, screenshots, and PDFs before making decisions. Results are presented in a clear, easy-to-understand format so users can spot risks faster, reduce manual review time, and make more confident fraud checks.

Ideal for compliance teams, fraud analysts, marketplaces, fintech platforms, KYC providers, insurers, and anyone who needs a practical way to assess whether visual content or documents may have been altered, forged, or AI-generated.
payload.longDescription:
检测图像和 PDF 文档中的欺诈、篡改和 AI 生成迹象。上传文件后，应用会分析可能的编辑、合成内容、文档篡改和 AI 生成视觉内容等真实性信号。

它帮助团队在做决定前快速审查可疑图像、身份证件、发票、对账单、截图和 PDF。结果以清晰易懂的格式呈现，帮助用户更快发现风险、减少人工审核时间，并更有信心地进行欺诈检查。

适用于合规团队、欺诈分析师、市场平台、金融科技平台、KYC 服务商、保险公司，以及任何需要实际评估视觉内容或文档是否可能被修改、伪造或由 AI 生成的人。

payload.name: Flowlity Co-planner
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Flowlity MCP Server lets authorized users inspect supply-chain sites, products, suppliers, orders, inventory, forecasts, promotions, capacity, alerts, imports, saved views, comments, and dashboard KPIs from Flowlity data through ChatGPT.
payload.longDescription: Flowlity MCP Server 可让获授权用户通过 ChatGPT 查看 Flowlity 数据，包括供应链站点、产品、供应商、订单、库存、预测、促销、产能、警报、导入记录、已保存视图、评论和仪表板关键指标。

payload.name: beglaubigt.de
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Beglaubigt sets up a German company — a GmbH or UG (haftungsbeschränkt) — directly in the conversation. Tell the assistant you want to incorporate and it collects the details one step at a time: company name and purpose, share capital, the shareholder(s) and managing director, and how you'd like to notarize. When everything's ready it returns a secure checkout link you open in your browser — the assistant never processes payment itself.

On the back end, Beglaubigt coordinates the notarization, the commercial-register (Handelsregister) filing, and your formation documents, so you can start a German company without assembling the paperwork yourself. It's built for founders in Germany and for international entrepreneurs incorporating there.

Currently supports GmbH and UG formation. After the checkout link, you complete payment and your notary appointment through Beglaubigt.
payload.longDescription:
Beglaubigt 直接在对话中帮助成立德国公司——GmbH 或 UG（haftungsbeschränkt，有限责任）。告诉助手你想注册公司，它会逐步收集详细信息：公司名称和经营目的、股本、股东和总经理，以及你希望采用的公证方式。一切准备好后，它会返回一个安全结账链接，由你在浏览器中打开——助手从不自行处理付款。

在后台，Beglaubigt 协调公证、商业登记册（Handelsregister）申报及公司设立文件，让你无需自行整理文书即可成立德国公司。它适用于德国境内的创始人，以及在德国注册公司的国际创业者。

目前支持 GmbH 和 UG 的设立。获得结账链接后，你需通过 Beglaubigt 完成付款和公证预约。

payload.name: Chiho AI
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Chiho AI connects ChatGPT to a user's Telegram account so they can search and read conversations, organize CRM tags, companies, tasks, summaries, and automation rules, safely preview and approve messages and group actions, and manage Telegram folders.
payload.longDescription: Chiho AI 将 ChatGPT 连接到用户的 Telegram 账户，让用户能够搜索和阅读对话，整理 CRM 标签、公司、任务、摘要和自动化规则，安全地预览并批准消息和群组操作，并管理 Telegram 文件夹。

payload.name: ChristianaCare Careers
payload.description: 查找 ChristianaCare 的工作机会
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
ChristianaCare Careers helps you discover job opportunities at ChristianaCare in one place.

Instead of browsing multiple pages, you can search for roles by job title, specialty, or location and quickly explore available opportunities across the organization. The app makes it easy to understand what each role involves and identify positions that match your experience and interests.

The app is designed to simplify career exploration within ChristianaCare. Whether you’re actively applying or just learning about opportunities, it helps you navigate openings without unnecessary complexity.

When you find a role that interests you, you can review the details and proceed to the official application process.

Key features
• Search jobs by title, specialty, or location
• Explore opportunities across ChristianaCare
• View role details and requirements in one place
• Access official application pages for each role
payload.longDescription:
ChristianaCare Careers 帮助你在一个地方发现 ChristianaCare 的工作机会。

无需浏览多个页面，你可以按职位名称、专科或地点搜索，快速浏览整个机构的职位空缺。该应用让你轻松了解每个职位的工作内容，并找出符合自身经验和兴趣的岗位。

该应用旨在简化你在 ChristianaCare 内的职业探索。无论你正在积极申请，还是只想了解有哪些机会，它都能帮助你轻松浏览职位空缺。

找到感兴趣的职位后，你可以查看详情并进入官方申请流程。

主要功能
• 按职位名称、专科或地点搜索工作
• 浏览 ChristianaCare 各处的工作机会
• 在一处查看职位详情和要求
• 访问各职位的官方申请页面

payload.name: Mindola
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Mindola helps you turn approved information about yourself, your work, or your business into a shareable Q&A page. Create a reviewable AI lens that can answer questions, explain what you do, guide visitors to the right next step, and preserve useful context. You stay in control of what is included, and nothing is created until you approve it.
payload.longDescription: Mindola 可将关于你本人、工作或企业的经批准信息，转化为可分享的问答页面。创建一个可审核的 AI 视角，用于回答问题、解释你的业务、引导访客采取下一步行动并保留有用背景。哪些内容被纳入由你掌控，未经你批准不会创建任何内容。

payload.name: Sellerise
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Sellerise brings your Amazon business data into ChatGPT - clear, structured, and ready to analyze.

Connect your Sellerise account to ask questions about sales, profit, advertising, inventory, keyword rankings, Amazon Search Query Performance, reviews, reimbursements, payouts, Subscribe & Save, and overall account performance.

Get fast answers without digging through dashboards: compare periods, spot profit leaks, find inefficient ad spend, identify stock risks, and see which products, campaigns, keywords, or search terms need attention.

Use it to understand what changed, what is driving performance, and where your Amazon business may be losing money or missing opportunities.

Sellerise uses read-only access to your Amazon business data, so you can analyze performance and make better-informed decisions without modifying your account. Sellerise is Amazon ToS-compliant, helping you analyze and understand your business while staying aligned with Amazon’s rules.
payload.longDescription:
Sellerise 将你的 Amazon 业务数据带入 ChatGPT，信息清晰、结构化，可直接用于分析。

连接 Sellerise 账户后，你可以询问销售额、利润、广告、库存、关键词排名、Amazon Search Query Performance、评价、补偿款、付款、Subscribe & Save 以及账户整体表现。

无需翻找仪表板即可快速获取答案：比较不同时期、发现利润流失、找出低效广告支出、识别库存风险，并查看哪些商品、广告活动、关键词或搜索词需要关注。

借助它了解发生了哪些变化、哪些因素影响了表现，以及你的 Amazon 业务可能在哪些方面亏损或错失机会。

Sellerise 以只读方式访问你的 Amazon 业务数据，让你分析表现并作出更有依据的决策，同时不会修改账户。Sellerise 符合 Amazon ToS，帮助你在遵循 Amazon 规则的同时分析和了解业务。

payload.name: Data247
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Data247 brings real-time contact and identity data into ChatGPT, for identifying and verifying contact information,  fraudulent activity, TCPA compliance, and more. 
 
Ask in plain language and ChatGPT runs the lookup for you: confirm whether a phone line is active and what carrier and line type it is, check whether an email is deliverable, validate a postal address, or find the person behind a phone or email. Before you call or text a US number, check it against the Do-Not-Call registry, and add numbers to your internal DNC list when someone opts out. Looking into a suspicious signup or order? Geolocate the IP for proxy/VPN signals and screen the details for fraud.

Upload spreadsheets or lists of data to be cleaned, appended to, or  validated, and ChatGPT will consult Data247 and give it back to you completely processed.

It's handy for keeping a CRM clean, validating and enriching leads before outreach, staying compliant with calling rules, and reviewing flagged accounts.

You must have an active Data247 account, and lookups are billed per use against your prepaid balance — checking your balance and rate card is free, and you can ask for either anytime.
payload.longDescription:
Data247 将实时联系信息和身份数据带入 ChatGPT，可用于识别和验证联系信息、欺诈活动、TCPA 合规性等。

用自然语言提出请求，ChatGPT 就会为你执行查询：确认电话号码是否有效及其运营商和线路类型，检查电子邮件是否可送达，验证邮政地址，或根据电话号码或邮箱查找相关人员。在拨打或发送短信到美国号码前，可查询其是否在谢绝来电登记册中，并在有人选择退出后将号码加入内部 DNC 名单。若要调查可疑注册或订单，可定位 IP 地址以检查代理/VPN 信号，并筛查相关信息是否存在欺诈风险。

上传需要清理、补充或验证的数据电子表格或列表，ChatGPT 会向 Data247 查询并将完全处理后的结果交还给你。

它适用于保持 CRM 数据整洁、在外联前验证并丰富潜在客户信息、遵守电话营销规则，以及审核被标记的账户。

你必须拥有有效的 Data247 账户；每次查询都会从预付余额中扣费。查询余额和费率表免费，你可以随时提出请求。

payload.name: Meticulate
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Meticulate helps B2B teams discover target accounts, find prospects, review and approve outbound proposals, inspect prospecting activity, and tune targeting and messaging workflows from ChatGPT.
payload.longDescription: Meticulate 帮助 B2B 团队发掘目标客户和潜在客户、审核并批准外联提案、检查客户开发活动，并通过 ChatGPT 调整目标定位和消息工作流。

payload.name: SignalSumo
payload.description: 在 ChatGPT 中查看你的 SEO 数据
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: SignalSumo connects your SEO account to ChatGPT. Ask about your tracked keyword positions and how they've moved, pull real Search Console queries, check a domain's backlink profile, see how often your brand appears in AI assistant answers, and start a technical site audit. Every answer comes from your own SignalSumo account under the same plan limits and quotas as the web app. Requires a SignalSumo account on a Pro or Agency plan.
payload.longDescription: SignalSumo 将你的 SEO 账户连接到 ChatGPT。询问已跟踪关键词的排名及其变化，获取真实的 Search Console 查询，检查域名的反向链接概况，查看品牌在 AI 助手回答中出现的频率，并启动技术网站审计。所有回答均来自你的 SignalSumo 账户，并遵循与网页版应用相同的方案限制和配额。需要拥有 Pro 或 Agency 方案的 SignalSumo 账户。

payload.name: Rhythm Systems
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Rhythm Systems is a strategy operating system for mid-market business leaders. This AI Connector gives your AI assistant secure, per-user access to your company's Rhythm data: strategic and annual plans, quarterly goals and KPIs, meeting agendas, tasks, Week in Sync notes, job scorecards, and dashboards. Ask about goal status, update priorities, prepare for meetings, and capture notes — all governed by your existing Rhythm permissions via OAuth. Requires a Rhythm Systems account with AI Connector access enabled by your administrator.
payload.longDescription: Rhythm Systems 是面向中型市场业务领导者的战略运营系统。此 AI Connector 为 AI 助手提供按用户隔离的安全访问，读取公司的 Rhythm 数据：战略和年度计划、季度目标与 KPI、会议议程、任务、Week in Sync 笔记、职位记分卡和仪表板。您可以询问目标状态、更新优先级、准备会议和记录笔记；所有操作均通过 OAuth 受现有 Rhythm 权限管理。需要 Rhythm Systems 账户，并由管理员启用 AI Connector 访问权限。

payload.name: Pingpong
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Pingpong runs your question through multiple AI models in sequence. Each model challenges and refines the work before one final answer is returned, with sources when current evidence matters. Use it to pressure-test decisions, plans, drafts, and claims that should not rely on one model alone.
payload.longDescription: Pingpong 会依次让多个 AI 模型处理您的问题。每个模型都会对工作成果提出质疑并加以完善，之后再返回最终答案；在需要最新证据时，还会附上来源。可用于对决策、计划、草稿和论断进行压力测试，避免只依赖单个模型。

payload.name: Asbie
payload.description: 你的 AI 商务伙伴
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Asbie is an AI-powered CRM companion that brings your customer and business data directly into ChatGPT.

Use natural language to search contacts, companies, deals, tasks, and notes from your Asbie workspace. Stay on top of customer relationships, track sales opportunities, and manage daily activities without switching between multiple applications.

Designed for freelancers, consultants, sales professionals, educators, small businesses, and growing teams who want a simpler and more efficient way to manage customer relationships.
payload.longDescription:
Asbie 是 AI 驱动的 CRM 助手，将客户和业务数据直接带入 ChatGPT。

使用自然语言搜索 Asbie 工作区中的联系人、公司、交易、任务和笔记。掌握客户关系、追踪销售机会、管理日常活动，无需在多个应用之间切换。

专为希望以更简单、更高效的方式管理客户关系的自由职业者、顾问、销售专业人士、教育工作者、小型企业和成长中的团队设计。

payload.name: WareMatch
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: WareMatch is the first 3PL warehousing marketplace. We connect businesses with 3pl providers tailored to their needs. 3PL operators get matched with brands that align with their capabilities, while brands receive bids from 3PLs who specialize in their particular needs. It's a direct, transparent way for both Brands and 3PLs to find the right fit and secure better logistics solutions.
payload.longDescription: WareMatch 是首个 3PL 仓储市场平台。我们为企业对接符合其需求的第三方物流（3PL）服务商。3PL 运营商会与能力相符的品牌进行匹配；品牌则会收到专门满足其特定需求的 3PL 报价。这为品牌和 3PL 双方提供了一种直接、透明的方式，以找到合适伙伴并获得更好的物流解决方案。

payload.name: inSitu Sales
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: inSitu Sales helps manufacturers, wholesalers, and distributors find customers and products; review pricing, inventory, visits, orders, estimates, and invoices; generate customer statements; predict order recommendations; and create or update sales records through ChatGPT. It connects with ERP and accounting systems—including QuickBooks Enterprise, QuickBooks Online, Odoo, NetSuite, SAP Business One, Xero, Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central, and more—bringing sales and operational data together in one connected workflow.
payload.longDescription: inSitu Sales 帮助制造商、批发商和分销商查找客户和产品，查看价格、库存、拜访、订单、报价和发票，生成客户对账单，预测订货建议，并通过 ChatGPT 创建或更新销售记录。它连接 QuickBooks Enterprise/Online、Odoo、NetSuite、SAP Business One、Xero、Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central 等 ERP 与会计系统。

payload.name: Johns Hopkins Careers
payload.description: 查找 Johns Hopkins 的职位
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Johns Hopkins makes it easy to find the right job seamlessly in ChatGPT. 

You can search open roles by title or keywords, then refine results by location and salary to help decide which opportunities fit you best.

Try asking things like:
- Find nurse jobs in Baltimore over $90k
- Show me medical assistant jobs

When you’re ready, click ‘View & Apply’ on ChatGPT, and you’ll go straight to the Johns Hopkins Careers site to complete the application.
payload.longDescription:
Johns Hopkins 让你可以在 ChatGPT 中轻松找到合适的工作。

你可以按职位名称或关键词搜索开放职位，再按地点和薪资细化结果，判断哪些机会最适合你。

可以尝试这样提问：
- 查找巴尔的摩薪资超过 $90k 的护士职位
- 显示医疗助理职位

准备好后，点击 ChatGPT 上的“View & Apply”，即可直接前往 Johns Hopkins Careers 网站完成申请。

payload.name: Pixelesq
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Connect your Pixelesq website to ChatGPT and manage it through conversation. Create landing pages by choosing from over 60 section types, generate content, and save pages ready to publish. Manage blog posts, team bios, case studies, and other structured content. Monitor Google Search Console rankings, indexing status, and site traffic. Update SEO metadata, create URL redirects, and customize your site's theme without leaving ChatGPT.
payload.longDescription: 将 Pixelesq 网站连接到 ChatGPT，通过对话进行管理。从 60 多种版块类型中选择来创建着陆页、生成内容，并保存可供发布的页面。管理博客文章、团队简介、案例研究和其他结构化内容。监控 Google Search Console 排名、索引状态和网站流量。更新 SEO 元数据、创建 URL 重定向，并在 ChatGPT 中自定义网站主题。

payload.name: Itcons.app Work Reports
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Itcons.app helps teams manage work reports.  This ChatGPT app lets authorized Itcons.app users securely connect their own Itcons.app account and query operational data from ChatGPT.
payload.longDescription: Itcons.app 可帮助团队管理工作报告。此 ChatGPT 应用允许获授权的 Itcons.app 用户安全连接自己的 Itcons.app 账户，并在 ChatGPT 中查询运营数据。

payload.name: Checkin
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Ask ChatGPT about the events your Checkin account can access—without exporting reports. Find events, attendees, contacts, and orders; monitor ticket sales and check-ins; review payment status and revenue; and compare event performance. All tools are read-only and respect your existing Checkin account permissions.
payload.longDescription: 询问 ChatGPT 关于 Checkin 账户可访问的活动，无需导出报告。查找活动、参与者、联系人和订单；监控售票和签到；查看付款状态和收入；并比较活动表现。所有工具均为只读，并遵循您现有的 Checkin 账户权限。

payload.name: Influencer Hero
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Influencer Hero is an influencer marketing platform for consumer brands. This connector lets you run your influencer program in conversation instead of clicking through the dashboard.

Discovery. Search a database of creators across Instagram, TikTok, and YouTube by audience demographics, engagement, and location. Pull full audience reports and verified contact details.

Outreach. List and inspect campaigns, add creators to them, and review the email flows and scheduled sends attached to each one.

CRM. Query your deal pipeline by campaign, board, funnel stage, country, or follower count. Open a deal for its history, notes, tasks, and scheduled communications. Create deals, move them between funnel stages, and log notes and tasks.

Collaborations and performance. Break down a collaboration's orders, revenue, top products, and performance over time. Pull campaign reports across date ranges, and review payouts and payout analytics.

Content. Search captured UGC across creators, campaigns, brands, and products, and manage creator submissions through review and approval.

Access follows the signed-in user.
